thread:
mira: FYI planned maintenance for us-west2 (cluster-51) this Sunday 01:00-05:00 UTC. Purpose: NIC microcode and minor GPU ucode tweak. We'll do 4 cohorts, rolling drains -> reboot -> 20m canaries. Expect up to 12-18% transient GPU capacity loss in hosted pools. Affected: hosted-api, dedicated-west, private-vpc-us-west2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/runbooks/us-west2-cluster51

sam: Can we start at 02:00 instead? traffic dips and reduces customer impact.

mira: 02:00 ok, updating calendar.

lee: Check pinned tenants on cluster-51. `infractl tenants --rack cluster-51 --format json | jq '.[] | select(.pinned==true)'.`

mira: two pinned tenants found. Sam will notify SEs.

infra-bot: [automation] Created ticket MNT-179123 and notified reserved-tenants and oncall.

finance: Cost estimate request.

mira: Region ~260 GPUs, 15% avg effect => ~39 GPUs * 4h = 156 GPU-hours. At ~$2/hr => ~$312 est. Final in postmortem.

ops-oncall: I'll add temporary alerts: hosted-api p50 >250ms (5m), error rate +0.5% (3m), host_evictions>2 in 10m. I'll monitor during window.

sam: Add rollback triggers: available capacity <20% baseline, hosted-api p50 >300ms for 5m, canary failrate>1% -> abort and revert microcode.

mira: Noted. Also pre-warm KV caches 30m before each cohort: `/bin/cache-seed --rack cluster-51 --duration 30m`. Scheduler policy to `cold-shed` during window.

sam: Any critical demos? I'll check customer calendar and carve out if needed.

mira: If no objections by Saturday EOD we proceed. Short post with impact/cost after window.
